lead.description: a variable associated with treatment that affects the outcome only through that treatment and shares no causes with the outcome

overview_sentence: An [instrumental variable](articles/instrumental-variable.qmd) moves treatment and, under extra conditions, identifies an effect of that treatment.

self_checks.title: Wald ratio
self_checks.prompt: The outcome means are 11 and 7, and the treated proportions are 0.75 and 0.25. What is the instrumental-variable estimand?

self_checks.title: Weaker first stage
self_checks.prompt: The treated proportion at Z = 1 falls from 0.75 to 0.65. The other values stay 11, 7, and 0.25. What is the estimand?
